adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. The variable name and subsequent permission check `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)` imply the intent is to allow either admins or owners; using `&&` makes the authorization overly restrictive and will incorrectly forbid legitimate team admins (or owners, depending on how these helpers are defined).
